request.not-in-scene: Hexplorer: You need to be in the same scene as the requested movement in order to confirm it.
request.player-message: Movement request forwarded to the Game Master.

fog.showColor: Toggle display of cell colors in revealed cells

revealRadius.name: Reveal Radius
revealRadius.hint: The radius of the revealed area in hexes. 0 means only the hex the token is on is revealed.

speed.name: Speed
speed.hint: The movement speed of the hexplorer token in scene units per hour. This is used to calculate time advancement.

hexTime.name: Movement Animation
hexTime.hint: The animation time in milliseconds to move one cell.

autoTriggerExplore.name: Auto Trigger Explore Action
autoTriggerExplore.hint: Automatically trigger the explore activities when a token moves into a cell. If your system requires a manual action from players to explore a cell, this can be disabled.

brushes.hint: Click on a cell on the canvas to configure it and/or save it as a brush. Click on cells with a brush selected to paint cells instead of configuring them.

apply.title: Apply Brush
apply.sameColorHint: Apply brush to all cells with the same color
apply.sameNameHint: Apply brush to all cells with the same region name

show-color.label: Display Cell Colors in Revealed cells

reset-fow.label: Reset Revealed Cells
reset-fow.title: Reset Revealed Cells?
reset-fow.content: Are you sure you want to reset the revealed cells? This action cannot be undone.

reset-discovered.label: Reset Discovered Regions
reset-discovered.title: Reset Discovered Regions?
reset-discovered.content: Are you sure you want to reset the discovered regions? The banner will be shown again when entering regions for the first time.

discover-activities.label: Explore Activities
discover-activities.hint: These activities will be executed when the hexplorer passes through the cell or ends its movement in it. Some activities can be executed only the first time the hexplorer moves to the cell.

explore-activities.label: Reveal Activities
explore-activities.hint: These activities will be executed when the the cell is first revealed.

revealed.label: Revealed
revealed.hint: A revealed cell will be visible to the players.

revealRadius.label: Reveal Radius
revealRadius.hint: The radius to reveal around this cell when revealing it. A value of 0 or more will override the hexplorer token setting.

discovered.label: Explored
discovered.hint: A explored cell has been traversed by an hexplorer token.

execute-only-on-explore.label: Execute only on explore
execute-only-on-explore.hint: Execute the cell activities only if the cell was previously not explored.

first-time-only.label: First Time Only
first-time-only.hint: Only execute the above activity the first time the hexplorer moves to this cell.

reveal-tooltip.label: Reveal Tooltip
reveal-tooltip.hint: Give observer permission to players for the journal page associated with the tooltip.

reveal-journal-entry.label: Reveal Journal Entry
reveal-journal-entry.hint: Allow players to open the Journal Entry associated with this cell in the General tab.

reveal-map-notes.label: Reveal Map Notes
reveal-map-notes.hint: Give observer permission to players to all the scene map notes present within this cell.

reveal.label: Reveal Cells
reveal.hint: Comma separated list of cells to reveal. Shift + Click on the canvas to add cells.

remove-hidden.label: Remove Hidden
remove-hidden.hint: Documents to remove the hidden status from when this activity is executed. Can be lights, tiles, sounds, tokens etc.

macros.label: Macros
macros.hint: Macros to execute when this activity is executed.

roll-tables.label: Roll Tables
roll-tables.hint: Roll Tables to roll when entering or traveling through the cell.

journal-entry.label: Journal Entry
journal-entry.hint: Journal Entry to open on click.

err.gridless: Hexplorer is not compatible with gridless scenes. Please select a grid type.
